messages:
maya (PM): Heads-up: support S-4123 (Sokara) — they requested streaming chat + incremental fncall frames delivered to their on‑prem webhook. Requirements: small per‑chunk header, schema validation, resume after disconnect, and ordering guarantees. Can we triage?

sam (Support): They reported data loss when a worker restarted. Current flow drops partial fncall outputs so their downstream state is inconsistent. Wants resume cursor + ack handshake + retry guarantees.

ravi (Sales): Sokara is evaluating Dedicated. If we can show a secure, resumable webhook demo they may commit to an enterprise deal. This is a high upsell.

lina (Eng): High level scope: define frame envelope (fields + seq), decide delivery semantics (at‑least‑once with dedup, or stronger), and design resume/cursor protocol. SDKs will need reassembly helpers.

adrian (Platform): For on‑prem delivery we should offer mTLS + signed JWT initially. HSM-backed signing is on the roadmap but not in MVP. Also need configurable retry/backoff and queueing to avoid OOMs on slow webhooks.

maya (PM): Sam — can you add the customer payload examples here? We need to know expected header fields and ack token format.

sam (Support): From ticket, sample frames: {"frame_type":"fncall_patch","call_id":"c-789","cursor":102,"payload":{"args_partial":"{\"email\":\"ops@sokara.com\"}"}}  and {"frame_type":"fncall_end","call_id":"c-789","status":"ok","result":{"user_id":1234}}  They expect each chunk to be schema validated and for their webhook to return {"ack_cursor":<n>} to advance.

lina (Eng): Implementation options: (A) JSON envelope per chunk (cursor, seq, call_id, payload) — easy resume & validation; (B) framed byte stream with boundaries — denser but harder to validate partial JSON. Recommend (A) for enterprise tier.

maya (PM): Proposed contract (MVP): event types = init|fncall_patch|fncall_end|meta|heartbeat; each event has call_id + seq + cursor; webhook must respond 200 + {"ack_cursor":<n>} to acknowledge; use last_ack on reconnect.

adrian (Platform): Need to document failure modes: webhook 5xx -> retry with backoff; webhook ack mismatch -> pause and alert; slow webhook -> bounded queue and drop policy config.

lina (Eng): Risks: cross‑instance ordering when reassembling large calls; backpressure and memory; SDK ergonomics for reassembly and resume; testing complexity for real‑world failure modes.

maya (PM): MVP launch criteria suggestion: API spec review, security sign‑off (mTLS/JWT), end‑to‑end demo with Sokara on Dedicated, resume/e2e tests, duplicate suppression verification, perf target p95 added latency <150ms.

lina (Eng): Rough estimate: MVP core (frames + resume + retry) = 3–6 weeks; SDK updates = 2 weeks; security/compliance review = 1 week. Add HSM/KMS integration = +3–4 weeks.

ravi (Sales): I'll draft a pilot commitment letter (6‑week pilot target) and loop legal for SOC2 notes.

sam (Support): I put the ticket into backlog and attached logs + repro. Customer asked for a quick webhook handler example — posted a tiny pseudocode snippet in the ticket.

maya (PM): Triage decision: create backlog ticket "enterprise-incremental-webhook". Prioritize P1 for Dedicated trial customers (Sokara class). MVP scope: Hosted enterprise + Dedicated with mTLS/JWT. Label=enterprise-streaming-webhook, milestone=Q2‑stretch. Owners: lina (eng), adrian (platform), sam (support), ravi (sales). Any objections? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:

lina (Eng): :thumbsup:

maya (PM): I'll create the backlog ticket and assign. Follow‑ups: sam — add full payload catalog; lina — confirm kickoff and swap T‑shirt estimate into ticket; adrian — enumerate security options and tradeoffs. Closing thread.
